producer: edgeX V2 settled funding history, venue-specific optional context
purpose: Qualify a small actual settled-funding sample for one selected crypto candidate; no adapter/adoption or full550 claim.
preconditions: Fresh compatible authority/own lease and separate positive exact provider/native/whole-budget admission by ROOT.
ROOT accepts or independently closes vendor raw rate-to-ratio serialization mapping; otherwise do not spend.
ROOT accepts retained canonical4STOCK asset evidence and current instrument-family mapping; ticker alone never sufficient. If not, stop before second read.
Provider no-auth route only; no key/signup/wallet/account discovery; no unknown trial.

cold_steps.purpose: Find the one approved native candidate contractName/contractId; optional unfiltered request is documented. Treat rows as incomplete/unqualified catalog facts, discard all unrelated/BTCETH data from saved receipt.
cold_steps.stop_if: Absent/ambiguous target, body>2MiB, inconsistent identity/status/family,403/429,auth/paywall,missing fields. No new classifier or quote inference.

cold_steps.purpose: At most2settled records; verify isSettlement, positive intervalMin, calculation timestamp ms and raw rate string. fundingTime remains a distinct native settlement clock.
cold_steps.stop_if: No semantic preapproval, no verified native id, missing/contradictory fields, source clock in future,403/429/auth/paywall/bodycap. No retry/pagination/second asset.

receipt_required: Native venue/id/name and separately approved asset join; original raw rate + unit evidence status.
fundingTimestamp calculation ms, raw fundingTime settlement clock, intervalMin, isSettlement; actual receive clocks and field-specific age.
Observed status/headers/actual physical attempts/bytes/latency, any provider quota evidence; no source age renewal.
Single selected candidate only. No unrelated prices/accounts, benchmarks, future zones or OI direction.
acceptance_boundary: This proposal can measure access/shape/cost/record consistency. It cannot prove serializer units or canonical identity from a sample, nor reconcile vendor prose contradictions. Unresolved prerequisites remain NULL/hold; no production normalization or activation.
